details.description: Base Meeting is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Base tier, tuned for conference room settings with multiple speakers captured by a single microphone. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Base, together with Enhanced and Nova 1, under "Legacy Models," and supports base-meeting for English only. It is built on Deepgram's end-to-end deep learning speech recognition architecture.
advantages: Deepgram documents it as "optimized for conference room settings, which include multiple speakers with a single microphone."

Deepgram describes Base-tier models as built on its "signature end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text model architecture," offering "a solid combination of accuracy and cost effectiveness in some cases."
disadvantages: Deepgram lists the Base tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview.
Deepgram states its Enhanced-tier models "generally have higher accuracy and better word recognition" than Base models and "handle uncommon words significantly better."
Supports English only (`en`, `en-US`), per Deepgram's language documentation.
use_cases: Transcribing multi-speaker conference-room recordings captured on a single microphone.

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to base-meeting were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Deepgram also offers an Enhanced-tier `enhanced-meeting` model, marked beta, which it says generally has higher accuracy than Base; that is a separate catalog entry, not this one. Legacy status: developers.deepgram.com/docs/model does not use the word, but developers.deepgram.com/docs/models-languages-overview groups Nova (1), Enhanced and Base under a 'Legacy Models' heading. The catalog carries no deprecation_date.
